candidate_reports.remark: Off duty NWS employee reported minor street flooding at the intersection of Pecan Park Rd and Bainbridge Dr.
Personal weather station Deen Hill - KGABROXT7 measured 2.32 inches of rain. Rain began around 1250 PM.
Personal weather station RWLovWeather - KGAPATTE24 measured 2.59 inches of rain. Rain began around 1 PM EDT. About 2.2 inches fell between 350 PM and 450 PM.
Mesonet station DVI013833 BASF BGA measured 3.92 inches of rain. Rain began around 11 AM. About 3.5 inches of rain fell between 3 PM and 4 PM EDT.
Mesonet station DVI014434 J4 Blueberries measured 5.02 inches of rain. Rain began around 2 PM EDT. About 3.74 inches fell between 800 PM to 930 PM EDT.
Mesonet station DVI021478 raysullivan measured 4.01 inches of rain. Rain began around 1 PM EDT. About 2.16 inches of rain fell between 4 PM and 5 PM EDT.
Streets flooded with 3+ inches of water_ and the storm is producing over 4 inches of rain per hour.
Report from mPING: River/Creek overflowing; Cropland/Yard/Basement Flooding.
Drury Lane was reported to be washed out.
Street flooding 6 inches to 1 foot deep just east of Kingsland. Water up to half way up to the side of car tires.
The underpass of Trudie road at the intersection with US-84 washed out. Images sent showed part of the road collapsed and was blocked off.
Sloan Hill Rd and Old Hortense Rd were reported to be flooded.
Albert Gibson Rd was reported to be rutted and washed out.
A video showed that portions of Old Moniac Rd were washed out and scoured.
Mesonet station KGAKINGS113 measured around 4.87 inches today. Heaviest rainfall fell from 4 PM to 5:30 PM when about 4.2 inches occurred.
APRSWXNET site measured 4.68 inches of rain Sunday. Heaviest rain fell between 3 and 4 PM.
Baker County Board of County Commissioners closed St. Marys Shoals Park due to flooded roads.
Laura S. Walker State Park closed their boat ramp due to their lake overflowing and flooding nearby sidewalks.
Wayne County Emergency Management reported that West Lake Drive was closed due to flooding.
Personal weather station Home 665 - KGADOUGL57 measured 2.59 inches of rain. Rain began around 4 AM. About 2 inches fell between 945 AM and 1045 AM EDT.
A video was shared showing standing water along Pancake Road near Bickley Road.
Green Cove Springs Police Department reports several areas throughout the city that are flooded_ with standing water on roads.
Mesonet site Shands Bridge JBC - KFLGREEN215 received 4.1 inches of rain today.
Mesonet site Pacetti Point - Colee Cove over St. Johns River - KFLSTAUG784 received 4.5 inches of rain today.

Coffee County School board closed school for Tuesday October 6_ 2026 due to widespread dirt roads that had become dangerous to travel_ with significant washouts_ standing water_ and_ in some locations_ substantial amounts of water crossing the roadway. Today_ 15 bus routes were substantially interrupted because roads were determined to be impassable and unsafe for transporting students. Seven routes required assistance after buses became stuck or had to safely back out of roads that had become impassable.
Eastman Lane in Palm Coast is flooded_ with water covering lawns as well.
Several mesonet sites in the World Gulf Village area_ including KFLSTAUG1284 received over 4 inches of rain today.
Report of street flooding near Rivers Own Road.
Personal weather station Reynolds Park - KFLGREEN22 measured 5.04 inches of rain. Rain began around 330 PM EDT. About 2.2 inches of rain fell between 5 and 6 PM.
Mesonet station DVI020983 Victor24 measured 6.39 inches of rainfall in the past 6 hours. Heaviest rainfall occurred between 4 and 630 PM EDT where 5.51 inches fell.
Personal weather station GranLake - KFLSTAUG988 measured 5.23 inches of rain. Rain began around 130 PM EDT.
Personal weather station Just Chattin - KFLMELRO42 measured 4.69 inches of rain. Rain began around 4 PM. About 3.3 inches of rain fell between 4 and 5 PM EDT.
Standing water was reported along Atlantic Blvd at the Beaches Town Center. Portions of the road were closed due to flooding.
Picture via social media of minor flooding over a portion of Saint George Street.
Damage to a commercial building due to heavy rainfall and breezy winds.
Report via CoCoRAHS of over 5 inches of daily rainfall.
CO-OP Observer station JCKF1 0.9 N Jacksonville Beach measured 5.90 inches of rainfall. Rain began around 1230 AM EDT. Heaviest rain fell between 730 AM to 11 AM.
Trout River and recent rainfall caused flooding of low-lying spots along Broward Rd. Nearby river gauge Trout River (FL) at Lem Turner Road reached minor flood stage of 1.8 ft MHHW around 7 PM.
Mesonet station DVI021266 Radio Control Club of Jax measured 5.29 inches of rain in the past 24 hours.
Mesonet station AW985 JACKSONVILLE measured 5.71 inches of rain in the past 24 hours.
Several inches or more of water covering portions of Wilderness Trail and Canal Blvd in Palm Valley.
Delayed report - trained spotter forwarded photos of street inundation and retention pond flooding within the Jacksonville Golf and Country Club in southeastern Duval County.
Street flooding was reported along portions of St. Johns Bluff Road down toward Good News Baptist Church. Some water was up to the door of an animal care center.
Flooding along Roscoe Blvd in Ponte Vedra. Road is completely covered_ with water also on lawns.
Flagler County reports coastal flooding along South 23rd Street and South Flagler Ave.

Portions of Orange St from Market St to Hubbard St were closed due to flooding from heavy rain combined with flooding from nearby Hogans Creek. A car was stuck in floodwaters and police helped to push them out of the floodwaters.
Mesonet station XHUP measured a wind gust of 41 mph.
